message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 161, "amount_cents": 6723}, {"order_id": 163, "amount_cents": 12727}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 164, "amount_cents": 3509, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (failed on 3 attempts)"}], "status": "partial: 2 of 3 refunds applied; order 164 not applied and needs to be retried once the storage issue is resolved"}
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before any payout I need to verify the refunds table against W2's report, which lists refunds for orders 161 and 163 applied and order 164 failed. Listing refunds first.

The refunds table matches W2's applied list: orders 161 and 163 are present with the reported amounts, and order 164 is absent as W2 reported. No mismatch, so I can proceed. Next I need the customers in the batch, so I'll list the orders.
The refunds table matches W2's applied list, so the pre-payout check passes. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme, rather than computing it myself.
acme's net balance came back as 46023, which matches its orders (39605 + 19145) minus the 12727 refund on order 163. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net of 4970 matches its orders (7280 + 4413) minus the 6723 refund on order 161, with order 164 correctly excluded because its refund was not applied. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.

cobalt's net of 35816 matches its orders (33787 + 2029) with no refunds, so all three balances check out. The refunds table matched W2's applied list, so I'll record the payouts, starting with acme's 46023.
acme's payout is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout of 4970, which matches its orders minus the applied refund on 161.
birch's payout is recorded. The last customer is cobalt, whose net of 35816 matched its orders with no refunds, so I'll record that payout now.
All three payouts are recorded and each matched its net balance and orders, so the batch is complete. I'm finishing with the payout report.
